issues.where: top-right crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%) across the flat terrain behind the crater rim
issues.what: a straight, razor-sharp horizontal seam line cuts all the way across the water and ground plane
issues.fix: weld or blend the terrain and water tile boundary so no straight seam is visible

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) where the three legs enter the water
issues.what: the legs clip straight into the water plane with no meniscus, concentric ripples, or foam, and tiny vertical white streak artifacts appear beside the legs
issues.fix: add displacement ripples, meniscus, and subtle foam where each leg breaks the surface, and replace the vertical streak drip artifacts with natural refracted droplets

issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%) on the lower legs of the left wading animal
issues.what: the lower legs look smooth and rubbery compared to the textured torso, with an abrupt painted-looking horizontal cutoff between dry pale skin and dark brown
issues.fix: carry fine skin micro-detail down to the feet and replace the sharp colour band with a gradual, glossy capillary wet-line transition

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) on the body and legs of the fallen animal
issues.what: the torso reads as smooth sculpted clay stamped with blurry, blocky dark noise speckles, and the waxy legs rest on the dirt with no dust, grime, or skin compression
issues.fix: increase skin texture resolution with organic pores and creases, break up the blocky speckles, and add ground dust and heavier contact shading where the body meets the rock

issues.where: top-left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%) along the backlit red plant fronds
issues.what: stippled, dithered pixel noise and bright dot halos break up the fine fronds against the sunlit mist
issues.fix: increase transparency and volume sampling quality so thin backlit foliage resolves cleanly without dithered halos

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%) along the foreground rock ledge and water edge
issues.what: the rock surface is soft, smeared, and clay-like, and clips into the water with no wet shoreline darkening, foam, or mineral crust
issues.fix: add high-frequency rock micro-displacement and grain, and build a darkened wet band and subtle foam or crust where the water laps the ledge

issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%) on the foreground rock slab
issues.what: the close rock ledge has smooth, blobby specular bumps that read like melted plastic or wet clay rather than fractured stone
issues.fix: replace the low-frequency glossy bump with sharp mineral micro-detail, varied roughness, and crisper rock edges

issues.where: bottom center-left teal pool and distant wading animals on the left
issues.what: the foreground pool has a flat, uniform teal colour with little depth or shoreline transition, and the wading animals leave no ripples around their feet
issues.fix: add depth-based absorption and subtle bottom variation to the pool, a wet mineral edge along the bank, and faint rings around the wading legs

issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%) around the small red plant and foreground rock
issues.what: the rock looks glossy and clay-like and the plant emerges from a smooth, pasted-on brown lump while the animal tendrils beside it read as stiff uniform wires
issues.fix: roughen the rock shader, blend the plant roots into real grit and crevices, and vary the thickness, droop, and ground shadow of the tendrils

issues.where: center animal's raised tendrils and lifted hind leg
issues.what: water dripping from the raised tendrils reads as stiff straight vertical lines and the water directly under the newly lifted foot shows no splash or ring ripples
issues.fix: break the drips into varied falling droplets and streaks, and add expanding ring ripples and small splashes beneath the lifted foot

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%) on the two small pebbles near the bottom right
issues.what: the pebbles look pasted onto the crust with an artificial sharp two-tone colour split on the right stone
issues.fix: nestle the pebbles into the surface grit with softer ambient occlusion and natural rock colour variation
